answer: Embedding a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function into the identity circuit forces each claimant to solve a puzzle whose depth equals the staked collateral, turning time into an unforgeable uniqueness proof. Slashing penalties scale inversely with solved delay so that any Sybil forger faces negative expected utility because the reward nectar is dwarfed by the cost of a terrace of computation; thus rational agents settle in a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates and even a sparrow adversary cannot amortize the delay across identities.
